name.description: the Name of the access control list.

i18n.en-US: the Name of the access control list.

ip_version.description: The IP Version of access control list is the type of its entry (IP addresses or CIDR blocks). It values ipv4/ipv6. Our plugin provides a default ip_version: ipv4.

i18n.zh-Hans: 访问控制列表的IP版本是其条目类型（IP地址或CIDR块）。它支持ipv4/ipv6。我们的插件提供默认的ip_version：ipv4。
i18n.en-US: The IP Version of access control list is the type of its entry (IP addresses or CIDR blocks). It values ipv4/ipv6. Our plugin provides a default ip_version: ipv4.
